title: low-latency-attention-microkernel-with-streaming-prefetch-and-fp16-accumulation
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Reduce tail latency and kernel-launch overhead for short and mid-length sequences while keeping continuous batching compatibility and KV cache semantics. This PR introduces a compact attention microkernel that performs streaming prefetch of Q/K/V tiles, uses FP16 accumulation with optional FP32 finalization (configurable via runtime flag), and exposes a scheduler hint so the request router can warm up KV cache lanes before a burst. Changes are conservative by default (feature gated) and include performance telemetry to validate improvements. High level: 1) New CUDA microkernel 'attn_stream_k' that: - streams query blocks into shared memory and prefetches corresponding key/value tiles via async copies, - performs k-v accumulation in FP16 with pairwise FP32 accumulation when use_fp32_accum=true, - emits KV cache writes in tiled batches to reduce global memory transactions, - supports in-place rotary/rope decoding transforms to avoid extra transposes and reduce memory traffic. 2) Router/scheduler integration: - scheduler hint prefetch.kv=true enables request routing to annotate requests that should trigger warmup prefetch of KV cache lines (used by Dedicated autoscaler and continuous-batching pipeline), - continuous-batcher updated to respect windowed prefetch hints and to coalesce prefetch work with existing batches. 3) KV cache: - updated eviction policy to prefer spill-on-large-commits and to mark prefetched lanes with reduced eviction penalty so warmups are preserved for expected bursts, - telemetry added to track prefetch hit rate and post-prefetch latency delta. 4) Runtime flags and safety: - feature gate runtime.attn_microkernel_enabled (default false), - runtime.attn_fp32_accumulation (default false), - fallback path remains the existing fused-kernel code path if kernel fails or feature is off. Benchmarks: Microbenchmark on A100 80GB (pytorch-like workload): - 1-token streaming latency down 19% median, 34% p95 for seq_len<=64 with batch sizes 1-8. - Throughput for continuous batching workloads improved 12% at tail latency SLO of 100ms. - KV-prefetch warmup shows 45% reduction in first-token latency for short-lived sessions in Dedicated. Performance notes: Measurements include kernel selection overhead; for long sequences (>1024) gains are small and scheduler falls back to existing high-throughput kernel. Related Linear: ENG-4982 (attn microkernel spike), ENG-5019 (continuous batching warmup). Checklist: - [x] Implementation of CUDA microkernel and fallback stub - [x] Router flag and continuous-batcher integration - [x] KV cache eviction policy adjustments and telemetry - [x] Unit tests for prefetch logic and scheduler hint propagation - [x] Perf canary and bench scripts added - [x] Docs: console runtime flags documented - [x] Safety: feature gated and feature flag off by default Rollout plan: canary on perf-canary fleet for 48h, watch prefetch_hit_rate and token latency regression alert; if >5% regression revert. If stable, enable for Dedicated as opt-in and then opt-out rollout. Risks and mitigations: - Incorrect prefetched KV could increase memory pressure; mitigated with lane marking and soft-eviction policy. - FP16 accumulation may cause minor numerical differences; gate and tests compare to FP32 baseline and allow only small KL divergence on logits. Notes: patch includes small refactor of the kernel dispatch table to let runtime choose microkernel by hint. Implementation details are in commits and the short patch snippets below.
commits: feat(attn): add attn_stream_k CUDA microkernel with prefetch loop
perf(scheduler): expose prefetch hint and wire to continuous-batcher
kv: add prefetched_lane token and eviction weight update
test: add unit tests for prefetch propagation and fallback
docs: document runtime.attn_microkernel_enabled and fp32 accumulation flags
review_comments: Ethan Brooks: Nicely scoped microkernel; can you add a safety net for device memory pressure? Consider tracking total prefetched bytes per-stream and capping it.
Maya Chen (author): Added stream-prefetch cap and dynamic backoff when device free memory < 10%; updated telemetry to surface backoff events.

Sara Alvarez: The FP16 accumulation path introduces tiny divergence in logit scale for some models. Please add a regression test comparing logits on small prompt sets and a config to force FP32 accumulation for model families that are sensitive.
Maya Chen (author): Added regression test that runs on perf canary with a 1k sample prompt matrix; added runtime.attn_fp32_accumulation flag and set to false by default.
Noah Kim: Small nit on dispatcher API naming; otherwise LGTM. Please squash the kernel commits into a single change and keep scheduler commit separate.
Maya Chen (author): Squashed kernel commits and rebased on main as requested.
release_notes: Introduces a new feature-gated attention microkernel (attn_stream_k) with streaming prefetch and optional FP16 accumulation that reduces tail latency for short sequences and improves continuous-batching throughput. Disabled by default; opt-in via runtime.attn_microkernel_enabled. Adds scheduler hint for KV warmup and telemetry to measure prefetch effectiveness.
